goal.text: Stay safe at the evacuation area.

intro.text: You are at the evacuation area. Your family is here!

hint.text: Where can you get true news?

lesson.text: Stay with your family. Listen to trusted news and do not go back inside.

choices.label: Go home now to get things
choices.heading: Not safe yet
choices.feedback: Do not go back into a damaged house. Wait until it is safe.

choices.label: Listen to the radio for news
choices.feedback: Listen to official news. Wait until it is safe.

choices.label: Share news you heard from others
choices.feedback: Get news from trusted sources. Do not spread rumors.

choices.label: Call friends on the phone all day
choices.heading: Not ready yet
choices.feedback: Use the phone only when you need it.
